newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mexican minister sees '97 growth higher than 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexican minister sees '97 growth higher than 4 pct.

text.p: Mexican finance minister Guillermo Ortiz said on Thursday the Mexican economy would probably grow faster this year than the finance ministry's four percent growth target but that it had not formally revised its forecast higher.
"It's a conservative target," he told reporters in Paris at the signing of an accord between and France and the Inter-American Development Bank.

"The assumptions underlying this forecast are quite conservative so its likely to be higher than that." He said private sector forecasts are calling for roughly 4.5 percent growth in Mexican gross domestic product for 1997.
